row:
Dr. Marty Greer and Laura Reeves deliver unique, fun, and fact-based conversations about pet health. Greer is the 2023 Westminster Kennel Club Veterinarian of the Year and the author of Your Pandemic Puppy. Reeves is the host of the widely popular, award-winning Pure Dog Talk podcast.

From pro tips on selecting your new dog to understanding what your dog’s runny eyes or your cat’s runny nose mean—and what you should do about it—Marty and Laura meet you where you are (in the car, on the treadmill, or walking the dog) and bring you a good laugh, a great story, and a bright idea every week.
